errors.evidence: The legend and the plot clearly show that VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, and PLLAVA all have circle markers, but the description states they have 'no marker'.

errors.text_span: The VideoLLaMB line starts at approximately 10 GB and increases steadily to around 410 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: The pink VideoLLaMB line represents one of the low-memory methods, staying well below 100 GB for the entire range. The description incorrectly describes a very steep increase to 410 GB, which is not what the line shows.

errors.text_span: starting at about 5 GB and reaching around 30 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: In the description of the VideoLLaMB-R line, the starting value is stated as 5 GB, but it is closer to 15 GB. The ending value is stated as 30 GB, but the plot shows it is closer to 35-40 GB.
The PLLAVA line starts at approximately 15 GB, not 5 GB.

errors.text_span: rises to approximately 130 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: The LLaVA-NeXT line rises to a value closer to 145 GB at 1000 frames, not 130 GB.

errors.text_span: The VideoLLAVA line starts at around 30 GB and sharply increases to about 410 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: The purple VideoLLAVA line goes off the top of the chart (above 400 GB) before the number of frames reaches 300. It does not extend to 1000 frames, so describing its value at 1000 frames is a hallucination of data points that do not exist on the plot.
The VideoLLAVA line starts at approximately 20 GB, not 30 GB.
